description: Data by Region is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics. Data by Region presents key Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) data by geographic area. Data includes population, economy, industry, income, education, employment, health, disability, family, community, migration and environment. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as twice a year, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
